required_results.title: Accurate learning with certified stable reduction
required_results.scope_review: The public theorem has the manuscript universal family/certificate-before-plant quantifiers, continuous physical-update reference class, exact origin and physical reconstruction, true full/reduced small-gain margins, finite actual physical autoregressive data loss, every positive fitting tolerance, and a sequence with loss tending to zero under one unchanged finite certificate. All gain-storage witnesses are derived. FamilyCertificateArithmetic proves the finite value is precisely the fixed eleven-scalar arithmetic expression. FiniteMatrixProtocol derives nominal Schur properties from the state storage inequalities, rather than treating a channel-gain oracle as computation. ExecutableIntegerWitness and ExecutableControlWitness prove soundness of integer/dyadic witness acceptance. Computable from finite matrices means verified finite matrix checks followed by the displayed scalar arithmetic; it does not assert total decidability for arbitrary unencoded reals, an IEEE execution theorem, optimizer convergence, reduced-order accuracy convergence, or physical-plant identification.

required_results.title: Certified nonlinear state reduction
required_results.scope_review: The finite-matrix certificate is infinity on invalid witnesses and equals epsilon + nominal error upper + reduced epsilon on valid witnesses. Its finiteness gives ambient-state GES (hence the defined GAS), both individual zero-state finite gains, and the full-to-reduced induced-gain error bound. Both residual choices are universally quantified and may differ while retaining the same global state/applied-input envelopes. All channel inequalities are consequences of explicit positive-definite storage and semidefinite BRL matrices. FiniteMatrixProtocol and CertificateArithmetic supply the finite-matrix/evaluation bridge; represented integer/dyadic acceptance has separate executable soundness proofs. Arbitrary-real total decision and IEEE arithmetic are not claimed.

required_results.title: Approximation within prescribed envelopes
required_results.scope_review: Exact real Euclidean norms. Targets use ContinuousMap on compact subtypes. All positive paper dimensions are covered (Lean also permits zero). Finite affine/ReLU expression trees are feedforward coefficient networks; the applied-input drive remains norm u. The printed supremum/infimum conclusions are proved, not assumed.

required_results.title: Uniform approximation with a fixed driving envelope
required_results.scope_review: Exact real Euclidean norms. Targets use ContinuousMap on compact subtypes. All positive paper dimensions are covered (Lean also permits zero). Finite affine/ReLU expression trees are feedforward coefficient networks; the applied-input drive remains norm u. The printed supremum/infimum conclusions are proved, not assumed.

required_results.title: Prescribed-envelope reservoir density
required_results.scope_review: Exact smooth normalization ν(h)=h/sqrt(1+norm(h)^2) and literal Euclidean concatenation. Actual finite ReLU approximation is uniform on the compact target domain, with the prescribed physical driving norm and fixed possibly rank-deficient B_delta. The same constructed network has the global reservoir norm identity. Literal appended-zero-column matrices have exactly equal Gramian injection products and actual induced gains for every nominal A and observation, including infinite gains. The approximation proof uses the exact open-unit-ball homeomorphism and continuity of compact-open postcomposition instead of the paper’s sharper derivative estimate; no approximation conclusion or gain equality is assumed.

required_results.title: Certified linear channel gain
required_results.scope_review: Both directions match the current named lemma. The printed block with X positive definite and its negative positive semidefinite gives the actual zero-state channel bound for every finite-energy applied input. For every real scalar strictly above the true induced gain, a positive-definite strict storage witness is proved from Schur nominal dynamics, with no controllability/observability premise. Actual Hilbert lp-2 channels match the existing signal norms; a proved coercive supply maximization and its exact prepend identity construct a symmetric finite Euclidean-coordinate storage matrix and the strict printed block inequality. Direct axiom audit reports only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

required_results.title: Nonlinear departures and stability
required_results.scope_review: Actual global Euclidean full and projected recurrences, all ambient initial states and every finite-energy applied input. The extended norm is a supremum of inclusive-prefix norms, proved equal to the true square-sum norm on finite-energy sequences. Actual induced gains are finite under the Schur spectrum condition, then causality/truncation supplies prefix bounds. The exact gain margin yields both state bounds, both nonlinear/nominal departure bounds, global exponential stability (and proved GAS), and finite individual output gains. Standing W_r V_r=I implies reconstruction injectivity. The named predicate is explicitly expanded into these conclusions; no desired gain/stability bound is assumed.

required_results.title: Certification with a prescribed reconstruction
required_results.scope_review: Full-column-rank V_r is represented by injectivity of its actual finite-dimensional linear map. Chosen certified uppers consistently define Γ and ε; choosing GainBounds.exact recovers the displayed exact-gain version, with exact_valid proved from Schur and the strict margin. The full and actual projected reduced recurrences have global exponential stability and the displayed individual finite gains. With B_u=0, both actual nominal responses are proved zero, giving ε+ε_hat. No W_r V_r identity or balancing premise is assumed.

required_results.title: Transfer to an exactly represented plant
required_results.scope_review: The physical state/output and actual lifted update are linked by an explicit global identity, C=S_y C_x, physical reconstruction C_x Φ(x)=x and Φ(0)=0. Induction proves equality of plant and reference trajectories/outputs for every input and every time. Independent reference and neural residuals obey the same global envelopes and share matrices/witnesses, yielding the displayed bound. Continuity and approximation are not required for this stronger comparison; no finite-data-to-global-identity implication is claimed. The fixed b_r0 premise is precisely the separately defined certified nominal-error upper.

scope: Nine general results with unchanged proof sources. The two published frozen-example results are outside this model-free export; fresh matrix witnesses are generated locally.

supporting_obligations.scope: The paper-facing wrapper retains positive-definite original Stein Gramians, the given invertible balancing matrix and both displayed balancing identities, ordered positive singular values, a strictly separated nontrivial retained order, all three augmented input ports, and the exact W_r/V_r formulas. It proves W_r V_r=I, Schur reduced nominal A, and the actual zero-state nominal applied-input/output error gain at most 2 times the discarded singular-value sum. The proof derives the dual inverse storage inequality from the controllability Stein equation, telescopes a single-tail cancellation, inducts over successive principal truncations, proves retained Schur stability by an eigenvector argument, transports both Stein identities and actual responses under T, and restricts augmented inputs to the norm-preserving applied-input embedding. No error-gain or balancing-error oracle remains. The balancing matrix is the object supplied in Definition def:balanced; no independent numerical algorithm for constructing it or IEEE identity of the saved projections is asserted.

The actual smooth normalization ν has the printed Euclidean Jacobian (νDerivative), its derivative operator norm is at most one, and its global Lipschitz constant is one. The sharp radial projection nonexpansiveness was already checked. These close the sharp estimates in the written density proof, independently of the previously verified alternative compact-open density proof.

Finite storage checks imply the certificate validity predicates, including both nominal Schur properties. The valid certificate and universal-family certificate equal the fixed executable arithmetic expression in eleven witness gains. Executable integer/dyadic positivity and BRL acceptance has real-matrix soundness proofs, including the sqrt(2)-scaled control channel. The actual frozen witnesses are checked in the kernel. This closes the represented finite-check/evaluation scope; no decision procedure for arbitrary unencoded exact real predicates or floating-point execution/physical-plant identification theorem is asserted.

identifications.lean: ℓ₂ z : ℝ≥0∞ = iSup_K ofReal(prefixNorm z K)
identifications.meaning: Proved finite iff the squared norms are summable; then equals ofReal(sqrt(actual infinite energy)). A divergent real tsum is never interpreted as zero.

identifications.paper: g_j and h_j, their hatted reconstructed/output versions
identifications.lean: channelGain A B O, g_u/g_δu/g_δz and h_u/h_δu/h_δz
identifications.meaning: Actual supremum of response/input norm ratios over nonzero finite-energy test inputs. O=I for full state, V_r for reconstructed state, C or C V_r for physical output. Schur finiteness is proved before conversion to reals.

identifications.paper: certified upper bounds substituted consistently
identifications.meaning: All six scalar choices and validity predicates are explicit. MatrixGainWitnesses validity uses the printed positive-definite storage matrix and semidefinite block inequality; channel bounds are derived.

identifications.paper: global exponential stability and GAS
identifications.meaning: Both predicates quantify over every ambient initial state. GES has an explicit positive prefactor and decay factor strictly between 0 and 1; GAS includes equilibrium, Lyapunov stability and attraction. GES implies GAS by a checked theorem.

identifications.paper: full-column-rank V_r
identifications.meaning: The usual finite-dimensional meaning of full column rank. A global inverse norm bound is derived; exact W_r V_r=I is sufficient but not needed by the prescribed-reconstruction corollary.

identifications.paper: finite coefficient ReLU networks of unrestricted capacity
identifications.lean: ReLUExpr finite inductive affine/ReLU computation trees; ReLUNetwork n p = Fin p → ReLUExpr n
identifications.meaning: Only constants, coordinates, addition, scalar multiplication and ReLU gates occur. Density is proved through lattice Stone–Weierstrass. This models finite feedforward computations, not a numerical optimizer or a trained checkpoint serialization.

identifications.paper: Delta_u(z,u) driven by the applied input
identifications.lean: Δ_u c_θ z u = norm(u) • rad(c_θ.eval(pack z u))
identifications.meaning: pack concatenates network arguments only. The driving norm is the applied-input Euclidean norm, not the norm of concatenated/lifted inputs.

identifications.paper: Omega concatenation and [B_delta 0]
identifications.meaning: Fin(p+d) concatenation is the standard-coordinate version of the earlier Sum-indexed Euclidean vector. Exact norm preservation, Gramian product equality and actual channel gain equality are proved.

identifications.paper: C_x dagger and Phi_theta
identifications.meaning: The exact matrix formula C_x.transpose * inverse(C_x*C_x.transpose) is used. Row-Gram positive definiteness and the right-inverse identity follow from global physical reconstruction. Centering preserves the origin.

identifications.paper: B_r = epsilon + b_r^0 + epsilon_hat, infinity otherwise
identifications.meaning: The exact-real conditional is infinity on invalid finite matrix witnesses. FiniteMatrixProtocol derives Schur validity from the storage checks; CertificateArithmetic proves its finite value equals the displayed eleven-scalar arithmetic expression, with an executable interpreter over rational values. Sound executable integer/dyadic witness checks are proved separately. Total decision for arbitrary unencoded real predicates and IEEE execution are not claimed.

identifications.paper: b_r superscript 0; independent residual superscripts (1),(2)

identifications.meaning: There exist finite positive transient multiplier τ and α in (0,1) bounding every pair of autonomous trajectories at every time. It is the zero-common-input specialization of the compared all-common-input condition. Already k=1 forces a finite global state Lipschitz constant. Exclusion is proved for every fixed continuous linear coordinate equivalence.

B_aug groups residual columns as p_u+p_z; this is the same Euclidean concatenation as the displayed three-port matrix. The intermediate algebra names T⁻¹ as R with both inverse identities. The exact real formulas are not asserted for the separately rounded frozen reductions.

identifications.lean: T*A*R, T*B_j, C*R in SimilarityMatrices and BalancedSteinCoordinates, with R=T⁻¹ in PaperBalancing
identifications.meaning: Both original Stein equations are transported by the stated balancing identities. The proof establishes equality of the actual applied-input/output responses; it does not assume that T preserves state norms.

scope_limits: The exact-real proofs do not establish identification of a physical plant from finite fitting data.
No optimizer-convergence or arbitrary reduced-order accuracy assertion is made.
The saved binary coefficients define exact-real recurrences; a bit-level floating-point execution theorem is outside the mathematical claims.

The frozen comparison excludes the specified global common-input contraction hypothesis for this ambient learned map and its linear coordinate changes; it does not exclude every method or every alternative representation.
